title: Outliers: typo, real event or fraud

videos.script: An order of almost twenty-seven thousand reais, at a grocer whose median order is fifty-seven. Delete it? {{big}} Not yet. An outlier is a value far from the others. Whether it is wrong is a separate question, and the answer is never in the number alone. {{separate}} This lesson meets three kinds. A total typed with a zero too many. A clinic buying Christmas baskets for its staff. And one account that ordered twenty-three times in three days and asked for every centavo back. {{three}} The statistical rules flag the clinic, which is real, and miss some of the typos, which are not. {{rules}} What catches the typos is a check against something else: the order's own lines. What explains the clinic is the customer's name and the date. What exposes the account is a pattern across its orders, not any single value. {{context}} And then there is a price in the catalogue with an extra digit, charged on five hundred and ten orders. That one is not cleaning at all. It is a phone call. {{end}}
